Automated translation (refer to source for accuracy)

Hanno Children's Library will close temporarily for facility repairs during the following period.

We apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

【Closure Period (All Day)】

December 4, 2025 (Friday) through January 15, 2026 (Friday)

【How This Affects Services】

• You cannot browse books, borrow, or return items at Hanno Children's Library during this time.

• If you have reserved materials for pickup at Hanno Children's Library, please pick them up at Hanno Central Library instead.

• The book drop box will remain available throughout the closure period.

Source (Japanese): https://www.hanno-lib.jp/calendar/post-85.html
